links.text:
Google is betting that AI will soon help build better AI: DeepMind calls recursive self-improvement a key part of their investment, abou 2027-2028.

DeepMind strategy chief Jasjeet Sekhon says recursive self-improvement is a “key part of the investment thesis.” He also admits current AI revenues do not yet sustain the capex.

Google is pre-building the compute for that possible discontinuity in AI R&D. DeepMind and OpenAI researchers reportedly place it around 2027–28.

Via The Information
